content.subproject: Disney Press Latin America and Disney Press Brazil Websites
content.detail: Onboarded and shepherded the launch of two Press Sites managed by Disney Marketing Teams in Brazil and Latin America. Trained the team's site producers on how to utilize the out-of-box tools provided through the proprietary CMS that I am product manager for. Coordinated the launch of this site with our infrastructure team. I also ensured that the site was set up for accessible standards and was localized per region based on available CMS tools.

content.detail:
The Disney Japan Team had a yearlong project where they migrated all of their sites onto our proprietary CMS platform. What was beneficial to all teams involved in this project was that the Japan team was able to more quickly migrate these sites by referring to branded style themes that already supported US sites (Disney.com, StarWars.com, etc.) as well as localization tools already available on the CMS platform.

As the Platform Product Manager, I managed the data migrations from their former sites to map to the data structures and content types of our CMS platform. As the Product Operations side of my team, I onboarded these team members onto the platform, assisted them as they built the sites on the CMS, and shepherded the individual launches of each website. I also ensured that each site was set up for accessible standards and was localized per region based on available CMS tools.

In total, there were eight site launches:

  1. Disney Japan
  2. Disney Kids Japan
  3. Star Wars Japan
  4. Marvel Japan
  5. "On Disney+" Japan
  6. Walt Disney Studios Japan
  7. Searchlight Pictures Japan
  8. Disney Healthy+tainment Japan

content.detail: Consulted and shepherded the rebranding of the Disney+ marketing site. The site's former url (disneyplusoriginals.disney.com) needed an update to reflect how the site's content would include more titles that are available on the streaming platform. Without needing to migrate all of the content from its former site to another one, I helped the production team by ensuring that all former urls would properly redirect to their updated counterparts and coordinated the launch of this site's new url with our infrastructure team.
